name: mecatl-model-router-config
description: Designs and writes a mecatl model router configuration (the `models:` subtree of ~/.config/mecatl/settings.yaml) tailored to the operator's preferences. Asks about priorities (cost vs capability, open vs proprietary, provider, multimodal) then searches the latest model benchmarks/pricing and recommends a complete alias + slot + router-category taxonomy. Use when setting up or revising model routing, picking models per slot, or building a subagent router taxonomy. NOT for provider/key wiring, permission config, or non-mecatl harnesses.
